records.evidence: Their 3 ops put +1 on Fort/Ref/Will with the note "against mental effects". Ours: core.json items.palatine-detectives-charm carries situational [{targets:[{kind:'save',detail:'all'}], when:'against mental effects, while you wear the charm', bonus:'+1 status'}] — one entry over all three saves, same trigger, and ours additionally types it as a status bonus (printed says status). Restricted bonuses render as conditional stars per the owner's Ruling A/B/C, which is why it is not folded into the total.

Their single op: +1 Athletics for underwater Swim. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1291 "diving-suit" → skill athletics, when 'on Athletics checks to Swim while underwater, wearing the diving suit', +1 item. We additionally carry the printed clumsy-1-under-armor clause on the core record's `situational` (they omit it) — printed states it, so not a divergence.

Their 3 ops: +1 to each save vs mental effects while asleep. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:2193 → save 'all', when 'against mental effects that occur while you are asleep in the bedroll (e.g. nightmare)', +1 status. Same trigger, same size; the 5 temp HP clause is display prose on both sides.

Their ops: a language-known conditional that either grants Shoanti or gives +1 Diplomacy while speaking it. Ours: core.json passiveEffects.grantsLanguages:['shoanti'] (live reader at src/rules/build.ts:6765, which pulls item language grants off invested inventory) plus src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1640 → diplomacy, +1 item, 'while speaking Shoanti to someone who understands it'. Player ends up with the language and the conditional star. Note: our `when` string is cut off mid-clause ("- only…"), so the "only if you already knew Shoanti" half of the condition is not visible to the player — co

Their select asks whether the resonant power is active; the Yes branch adds void resistance 1, both branches carry the 1 HP/minute as text. Ours: core.json effectChoices id 'resonant' with a yes option granting passive resistances [{void,1}] and a no option granting nothing, plus a `situational` hp entry carrying the 1 HP/minute prose. Item effectChoices are resolved live at src/rules/build.ts:5645 and src/rules/play.ts:2035, and rendered in src/sheet/ItemDetail.tsx:332. Same gate, same resistance.

Same shape as the Shadde-Quah emblem: their conditional gives Shoanti or +1 Diplomacy. Ours: passiveEffects.grantsLanguages:['shoanti'] on the core record (read at src/rules/build.ts:6765) + src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1641 diplomacy +1 item. We also carry the once/day innate liberating-command from the printed activation (edition 'remaster', not superseded); they encode no spell there, and printed states it.

Their 7 ops put +1 on each of the Recall-Knowledge skills (Arcana, Crafting, Medicine, Nature, Occultism, Religion, Society) for the compendium's broad topic. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1620 uses one entry with target skill 'all' and when 'after spending 1 minute referencing the compendium…', +1 item — i.e. every skill, which is what the printed text says ("a skill check to Recall Knowledge about the subject"). Ours is a superset that follows the print; the only skills it covers beyond theirs are ones a Recall Knowledge check could legitimately use (Lore, Performance, …).

Their ops: flat +1 Survival plus display text for the Subsist crit-success clause. Ours: core.json passiveEffects.skills.survival:1 (a real +1 in the total, same as theirs) plus src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:443 as a display star noting 'while worn and invested'. The star is display-only by design (situationalBonuses.ts header, lines 10-12: "It is DISPLAY-ONLY: nothing here changes a computed number"), so there is no double count. The Subsist clause is prose on both sides.

Their op: +1 Athletics to Climb with the kit. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1604 → athletics, 'to Athletics checks to Climb while using the kit (you move at half Speed while attached)', +1 item. Same skill, same trigger, same size.
Their op: +1 Crafting to Repair. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1616 → crafting, 'to Repair an item using Crafting, with the kit in hand (or worn, drawn as part of the action)', +1 item.

Their single op: +1 Athletics to Climb, Force Open, High Jump, Long Jump. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:2208 → athletics, 'on Athletics checks to Climb, Force Open, High Jump, or Long Jump', +1 item. Identical action list. (The once/day reroll activation is encoded by neither side.)

Their conditional branches on an undead physical feature: vitality 5 for the undead branch, void 5 otherwise. Ours: core.json items.channel-protection-amulet.passiveEffects.resistances = [{void,5,unlessCreatureTrait:'undead',condition:'against damage from harm spells, while you\'re living'},{vitality,5,whenCreatureTrait:'undead',condition:'against damage from heal spells, while you\'re undead'}]. Both gates are live at src/rules/derive.ts:2459-2460. Same split, same damage types (harm→void for the living, heal→vitality for undead), same value.

Their two ops: +1 Reflex against your own and allies' spells, and splash resistance 3. Ours has both — src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1172 gives the +1 circumstance Reflex with the same trigger, and core.json items.backfire-mantle.passiveEffects.resistances carries {type:'splash', value:3, condition:'against splash damage from your own alchemical items and those of your allies'}. The greater grade is present too (situationalBonuses.ts:1173, +2).

Ours: core.json items.trackers-goggles.situational [{skill survival, when 'to Sense Direction or to Track', '+1 item'}]; the retry clause is prose in the rendered description on our side too.

Their op: +1 Athletics to Force Open anything pryable. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1608 → athletics, 'to Athletics checks to Force Open something that can be pried open (holding the crowbar)', +1 item.

The +1 damage is prose on our side too (src/rules/modes.ts:254 carries the Overdrive mode with a note and no numeric modifier), so both sides leave it to the player.

Same conditional as the other two emblems. Ours: passiveEffects.grantsLanguages:['shoanti'] (read at src/rules/build.ts:6765) plus src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:2901 diplomacy +1 item while speaking Shoanti. Same truncated-`when` cosmetic note as the Shadde-Quah entry.

Their op: +1 Deception to Impersonate with a kit. Ours: src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1609 → deception, 'to Impersonate someone using a disguise set up with the kit', +1 item.

Their single op: flat +1 Diplomacy. Ours: core.json items.glasses-of-sociability.passiveEffects.skills.diplomacy:1. Identical; the name-recall activation is prose on both sides.

OWNER-RULED — the divergence is real and is the one he already authorised. Their side computes +5 when not raging and +10 while their rage mode is active; ours carries landSpeedBonus 5 with the raging half as a situational star. The standing ruling (2026-08-22, verbatim): 'we give an actuall speed only when its alwayes, if it is deoendednt on somthing ist in a *'. A Speed that exists only while raging is exactly the conditional case, so the star IS the ruled encoding. The finding's load-bearing claim — that the app already treats a mode-gated Speed as evaluable and this record is the outlier — was checked and is false.

FIXED. 'When you don't have panache, you still get half this status bonus to your Speed, rounded down to the nearest 5-foot increment.' That half is ALWAYS ON, and the owner's standing rule is 'we give an actual speed only when it's always; if it is dependent on something it's in a *' — so the clause splits: the floor becomes a real number and only the panache-dependent remainder stays a star. Before this the record carried no number at all and a 19th-level swashbuckler standing without panache read 25 ft where the book gives 40. The ladder is what blocked it: the floor is 5 ft (L3-10), 10 ft (L11-18), 15 ft (L19+) — the printed full bonus halved and rounded down at every tier — and landSpeedBonus was typed number, so two of the three tiers had no carrier. The field now accepts a FORMULA in the vocabulary every other speed value already uses, resolved through resolveFormula in ONE helper shared by the feat / class-feature / heritage reads, and explain.ts resolves it the same way so the Speed breakdown still sums to the total. Value '5+5*min(2,floor((@actor.level-3)/8))', checked against the printed halving at every level 3-20 by the backfill script itself, which refuses to write if any tier disagrees. That reproduces WG's two unconditional ops ([L>=11 -> +10], [L>=19 -> +15]) plus the ELSE branch (+5) of their panache conditional, read through status bonuses not stacking — their sheet shows the same number ours now does, and their encoding does not contradict print here, so no ruling was needed. The star was reworded in the same change to 'while you have panache … (half of it … is always on and already in your Speed)', in the wording the clarity-goggles-greater / mirror-goggles stars established — two carriers stating the same feet is how a sheet contradicts itself. Its sibling stylish-combatant is deliberately left as a star and tested as the control: +5 only WITH panache, no unconditional half. test/vivacious-speed-floor.test.ts (15).
